title: Rescheduling a Meeting

title: Meeting Action Points
description: Turn these notes into clear action items: 'John to check budget; Sarah will email the design team; we need to finalize the date by Friday; next sync is Wednesday.'

title: Excel Formula Help
description: Explain in simple terms how to use the VLOOKUP function to find a price in a list of products, given the Product ID.

title: Quarterly Review Outline

title: Polite Project Rejection

title: LinkedIn Work Update

title: Sales Data Summary

title: Brainstorming Agenda

title: Office Move Announcement
description: A draft says: 'We move next week. Bring your boxes.' Improve this into a professional and clear announcement for the whole company.
